task_completion.description: LibreCAD is open and the drawing environment is set up with the required layers.

task_completion.description: The road cross-section geometry is drawn symmetrically around X=0 with a dashed centerline.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A vertical dashed magenta line is at the center. The drawing shows a symmetric layout with lanes, curbs, and sidewalks on both the left and right sides of the center axis.

task_completion.description: The pavement structure includes asphalt and aggregate base layers with a subgrade line.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Below the road surface, there are distinct horizontal layers. The VLM should see a top layer (asphalt), a middle layer (aggregate), and a bottom line (subgrade) in the correct layer colors (White, Green).

task_completion.description: Sidewalks and curbs are placed at the correct elevations and offsets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Cyan sidewalk blocks are visible at the outer edges. Yellow curb structures are visible between the sidewalk and the sloped road surface. The sidewalk surface appears higher (Y=5.0) than the road gutter (Y=0).

task_completion.description: The drawing includes specific dimensions (12', 24', 5') and text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Red dimension lines show '12', '24', and '5'. Blue text labels are visible for 'ASPHALT SURFACE', 'AGGREGATE BASE', 'SIDEWALK', 'CURB & GUTTER', and 'CL'.

task_completion.description: The drawing is saved to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the path /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/road_cross_section.dxf.

integrity.description: The agent used the LibreCAD GUI tools rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with LibreCAD toolbars (lines, layers, dimensions) and the drawing canvas.
Sequential screenshots show the progression from an empty canvas to a completed cross-section, rather than the drawing appearing instantly.

integrity.description: The agent did not copy an existing DXF file into the directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Line', 'Offset', or 'Layer' tools within the LibreCAD interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The drawing must be symmetric around X=0. Key coordinates: Sidewalks at X=-21 to -16 and X=16 to 21 (Y=5.0). Centerline Y=2.4, Gutter Y=0. Layers: PAVEMENT (White), CURB_GUTTER (Yellow), SIDEWALK (Cyan), SUBGRADE (Green), DIMENSIONS (Red), CENTERLINE (Magenta/Dashed), ANNOTATIONS (Blue). Required text: 'ASPHALT SURFACE', 'AGGREGATE BASE', 'SIDEWALK', 'CURB & GUTTER', 'CL'. Vertical exaggeration is 10:1 (1ft = 10 units).
